label: Bear Case
rationale: Pricing and volume normalize faster, margin gives back part of the post-CCBA mix benefit, reinvestment stays elevated, and valuation risk premia remain higher

label: Base Case
rationale: 2026 FX tailwind is removed, growth fades gradually toward a mature rate, and only modest post-CCBA margin and capital-intensity improvement is recognized

label: Bull Case
rationale: Brand pricing and emerging-market volume remain resilient, asset-light mix produces operating leverage, and lower risk premia accompany stronger terminal economics
